messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — we're rolling out the Data Residency Enforcement policy for Private/VPC customers starting in two weeks. This adds a strict enforcement mode so customer traffic and persisted telemetry are constrained to configured regions. Docs + rollout plan: https://redwood.internal/docs/private/data-residency-enforce (internal).

Marta Gomez: Important: legal requires customers sign the updated data processing addendum for enforcement to be enabled. I'll post the template and who needs e-signature.

Leo Park: Infra note: the enforcement is implemented as a per-tenant toggle (`data_residency_mode: enforced|advisory`). When set to `enforced` we block egress to non-authorized regions at the edge routing layer. Config preview:```yaml
tenant_config:
  data_residency_mode: enforced
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
```
This will be available in Private v2.6 agent and console v3.1.

Sam Reynolds: Who owns comms to existing Private customers? Need a standard FAQ + opt-in flow for early customers. Also: impact on cross-region DR setups?

Priya Nair: CS will handle customer outreach; Sam can you own the FAQ draft? Early-DR customers will need migration guidance — Leo we should include an appendix for DR patterns that are compliant. Schedule:
- Week 0: feature behind toggle for internal dogfood tenants
- Week 1: soft rollout to Pilot customers (by request)
- Week 2: global opt-in/opt-out window + contractual cadence
- Week 3: enforcement enabled for tenants with signed agreement

Marta Gomez: For sales — we need checklist for contract amendments. I'll share a short checklist in #sales later.

Compliance Bot: AUTOMATED: Compliance ticket created #COM-4721. Review needed: data processing addendum + audit trail retention. Due in 7 days.

CS Ops: Support runbook uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-data-residency.md — includes troubleshooting, rollback steps, and a contact matrix for on-call infra.

Sam Reynolds: I'll post the FAQ draft by EOD tomorrow and ping @marta for legal review.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — main asks: (1) CS to draft customer comms/FAQ (Sam) (2) Legal to prep DPA template + checklist (Marta) (3) Infra to finalize config docs & DR appendix (Leo) (4) Support to validate runbook (CS Ops). Ping me for blockers. :lock: :earth_americas:
